description: Source code for the SpdifStreamOut class, which handles SPDIF output streaming in Android's AudioFlinger, including opening streams, handling formats, and writing data through an SPDIF encoder.

classes.name: SpdifStreamOut
classes.description: Handles SPDIF stream output, including opening, writing data, and resetting encoder.

methods.name: SpdifStreamOut
methods.description: Constructor initializing SPDIF stream with device, flags, and format.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Resets the SPDIF encoder and flushes the output stream.

methods.name: standby
methods.description: Resets the SPDIF encoder and puts the stream into standby.
